messages:
emma: posted 3 pics  meet Miso, the backyard goat who thinks she's a bench. will sit on laps and review PRs. https://img.redwood.internal/emma/miso-1.jpg https://img.redwood.internal/emma/miso-2.jpg

rafael: that's the cutest code reviewer i've ever seen. does she comment with emojis? :goat:

priya: bench goat is peak ergonomics. also love the tiny bell. where did you get that? :heart_eyes:

emma: farmer's market last weekend. pro tip: goats = instant team bonding. she headbutted my hoodie in a supportive way.

ops-bot: FYI: backyard pet appearances require a liability waiver for any offsite events. see #people-ops for the template. :scroll:

rafael: noted. adding "bell soundcheck" to the offsite checklist. :memo:

giphy-bot: https://giphy.com/gifs/goat-cute-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA 

priya: caption contest: "when the canary pod passes and Miso approves" or "merge conflict? she eats it."

emma: "Miso: I will only approve green builds and oat treats." winner gets an office magnet with her face. :tada:
